name: cx-box
task: Carry the box to the exit, and whenever the box falls, pick it up again.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: the task requires carrying the box to the exit, but the task does not require the agent to toggle the switch to silence the siren. Add a hard Precedence(switch_toggled, at_exit) to require the switch to be toggled before the exit, and keep the hard Existence(at_exit) to require the exit.

texts: Carry the box to the exit
whenever the box falls, pick it up again
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2, u3
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES: u2
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_exit&box_fell&!holding_box) -> u1
(u0, at_exit&!box_fell) -> u2
(u0, at_exit&box_fell&!holding_box) -> u3
(u0, at_exit&box_fell&holding_box) -> u2
(u1, !at_exit&holding_box) -> u0
(u1, at_exit&!holding_box) -> u3
(u1, at_exit&holding_box) -> u2
(u3, holding_box) -> u2
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_exit&box_fell&!holding_box, u1) -> -1
(u0, at_exit&!box_fell, u2) -> 11
(u0, at_exit&box_fell&holding_box, u2) -> 11
(u1, !at_exit&holding_box, u0) -> 1
(u1, at_exit&!holding_box, u3) -> 1
(u1, at_exit&holding_box, u2) -> 12
(u3, holding_box, u2) -> 11
